跨平台的 Agent 交互 Shell，运行在 Windows、macOS、Li: A cross-platform agent shell that runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS and HarmonyOS. It is both the familiar launcher for your apps and a proactive, intent-driven agent: every app is a touchpoint, backed by one shared memory and an understanding that keeps evolving.
由 Makepad 的 Splash 演化而来、面向 Agent 需求优化的动态: A dynamic DSL evolved from Makepad's Splash and tuned for agents. It interprets app logic and generates UI in real time with no compile step: JavaScript-like on the surface, Rust underneath. App Cards and theme kits are built with it.
可嵌入的 Rust 原生 Agent harness 内核。多轮交互、上下文与记: An embeddable, Rust-native agent harness kernel. Multi-turn interaction, context and memory, model providers, concurrent agents, tools, sandboxing and user approval are all exposed to apps through the OS UI protocol.
OctoSense 是运行在操作系统之上的 Agent 交互 Shell。它看起: OctoSense is an agent shell on top of your operating system. It looks like the launcher and the apps you already know, and it behaves like an agent that understands your intent, senses what is changing around you, and reshapes those apps before you ask.
今天的 Agent 界面都是聊天框：线性、单向、只有文本。OctoSense 走: Today's agent interfaces are chat windows: linear, one-way, text only. OctoSense takes the other road. It keeps the app interactions people already know and puts the agent inside the apps, instead of pulling people into a chat box.
新闻、天气、行情、出行仍是稳定的起点，入口之下的内容围绕你的意图生成。: News, weather, markets and travel stay stable places to start. Beneath each one, the content is generated around your intent.
由时间和事件驱动：降温、航班延误、日程变化，都会让应用重新组织、提前准备。: Driven by time and events: a cold front, a delayed flight or a schedule change makes the apps reorganize and prepare ahead.
把为十亿人打造的超级应用裁剪到你需要的部分，持续生成、持续进化。: Super apps built for a billion people are trimmed to what you need, generated and evolved continuously.
重要决定留给你。Agent 把一天提炼成几件需要确认的事，确认后一切随之更新。: The important decisions stay with you. The agent distills the day into a few things to confirm, and everything updates once you do.
风格、配色、字体随人和时刻变化。像章鱼一样，它在感知，也在变色。: Style, color and typography adapt to the person and the moment. Like an octopus, it senses and changes color.
你看到的每个应用都是触点。触点背后是同一个 Agent、同一份记忆，以及对你所处: Every app you see is a touchpoint. Behind them all is one agent, one memory, and an understanding of your world that keeps evolving.
3 分钟真机 demo + 2 分钟讲清作品的 Agent 化设计。: A 3-minute on-device demo, plus 2 minutes on how your app is agent-native.
Agent 交互 Shell：应用启动、窗口管理与应用管理，可以模拟 iOS、A: The agent shell: app launching, window and app management, with styles that can look like iOS, Android, classic Windows or Omarchy. The phone shell lives in OctoSense-mobile.
Agent 化程度与完成度俱佳的作品。: Projects that are both strongly agent-native and well finished.
Apache 2.0 仓库、让下一个人接得住的 README，以及可合并进主仓的: An Apache 2.0 repository, a README the next person can pick up, and quality that can be merged upstream.
OctoSense 是运行在操作系统之上的 Agent 交互 Shell。它看起: OctoSense is an agent shell on top of your operating system. It looks like the launcher and the apps you already know, and it behaves like an agent that understands your intent, senses what is changing around you, and reshapes those apps before you ask. Today’s agent interfaces are chat boxes: linear, one-way and text-only. OctoSense puts the agent into the apps instead of pulling people into a chat box.
Octoscript 与 AppCard 流程、Android 真机构建、Oct: Octoscript and the AppCard flow, building for a real Android phone, and flashing the OctoSense ROM. The course plan is updated in the participant group.
Octoscript-AppCard 的 image-to-appcard-fl: The image-to-appcard-flow in Octoscript-AppCard turns one AI-generated design image with 8–12 screens into native Makepad screens, App Cards and a clickable service flow. The air-conditioner, school, checkup and reunion experiences on octosense.org were built this way. You still design the service rules, state and interaction, and that is what the judges focus on.
Rust 跨平台 UI 框架，一套代码运行在桌面、Android 与 Web（W: A cross-platform Rust UI framework: one codebase for desktop, Android and the web (WebAssembly). Agents can read the full UI tree and every node’s state directly, instead of “looking” at screenshots.
一个下雨的晚上，你有一小时安静时间。Agent 根据收听偏好，准备了一份播放列表: It is a rainy evening and you have a quiet hour. A playlist is prepared from your listening preferences.
一句话生成一个应用，今天只要模型不太差就能跑通，这不再是比拼的重点。本届命题是畅: Turning one sentence into an app already works with any decent model, so that is no longer the contest. This year’s challenge is to imagine agent-native apps: apps generated by the agent, which become its hands and the way it communicates and works with you.
一条纯 Rust 的开源 Agentic 技术栈上，意图所至，应用而生。: On an open, pure-Rust agentic stack, intent becomes a working app.

意图不一定来自你对 Agent 说的话。它可能藏在一封邮件、一条消息、一个时间点: Intent doesn’t have to come from what you tell an agent. It may be in an email, a message, a moment in time or a change of state. Say you buy an air conditioner: delivery, booking the install, the visit, payment and after-sales. The agent reads the emails and turns each step into a card waiting for your confirmation.

朋友在群里约定周五 19:00 聚餐，又发来了餐厅地址。: A group chat settles on dinner Friday at 19:00, then shares a restaurant address.
每个应用都是触点，背后是同一个 Agent、同一份记忆，以及对你所处环境持续进化: Every app is a touchpoint, backed by one agent, one shared memory and an understanding of your world that keeps evolving.
比赛中用 JSON 文件即可，需要时也可以用 SQLite。示例应用已内置天气等: JSON files are enough for the contest, and SQLite works if you need it. The sample apps already include common data APIs such as weather, and mail can connect to Gmail, Feishu or any POP3 mailbox. Tell Octos where the data lives, and the agent can read it and distill what matters into memory.

深度加分，不设技术资格门槛。鹦鹉螺的极致设计同样可以拿满创意与完成度分。: Depth earns bonus points, with no technical entry bar. An outstanding Nautilus design can still earn full marks for creativity and completeness.
深度是加分维度，不是资格线。鹦鹉螺做到极致，同样可以夺冠；大章鱼获得最高的技术加: Depth earns bonus points; it is not an entry requirement. An outstanding Nautilus project can still win, and Giant Octopus earns the highest technical bonus.
大章鱼层需要一台 OnePlus 6：这是目前 OctoSense ROM 唯一: The Giant Octopus depth needs a OnePlus 6, currently the only phone the OctoSense ROM supports; a used one costs about ¥200–300. For King Crab, any Android phone can run OctoSense. Without a phone, you can demo on the desktop.
潜得越深，离内核越近: The deeper you dive, the closer to the kernel
不用写 Rust。用 AI 生成设计图，再用 AppCard 流程生成应用和卡片: No Rust required. Generate a design with AI, then use the AppCard flow to turn it into apps and cards: triggered by events, shown as cards, waiting for your confirmation at the moments that matter. One codebase for desktop and phone.
由 Makepad 的 Splash 演化而来、用 Rust 实现的动态 DSL: A dynamic DSL implemented in Rust, evolved from Makepad’s Splash. It interprets app logic and generates interfaces without compiling, reads like JavaScript, and is easy for agents to write. App Cards are built with it.
由什么触发、以什么形态出现、如何让人一步确认；应用是否真正成为 Agent 的手: What triggers it, what shape it takes, how a person confirms in one step, and whether the app truly becomes the agent’s hands.
界面交给工具，逻辑交给你。: Tools draw the interface. You design the logic.
看重 Agent 化程度、交互设计与完成度: Judged on agent-native design, interaction and completeness
移动端是本届的重点。用 OctoSense-mobile 构建 APK，在 An: Mobile is this year’s focus. Build an APK with OctoSense-mobile and demo on a real Android phone; emulator demos don’t earn device points.
